channel.title: Ocean News & Technology Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: AUKUS Nations to Build on Uncrewed and Autonomous Technology Successes from 2025
item.description: The use of uncrewed and autonomous technology to deter threats above, on, and below the water will continue this year, building on the success of trials and tests in 2025.

item.title: Transocean to Acquire Valaris
item.description: Transocean Ltd. and Valaris Limited announced the signing of a definitive agreement to combine the two companies under which Transocean will acquire Valaris in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $5.8 billion (all currency in USD). The shareholding percentages of the combined company, on a fully diluted basis1, will be approximately 53% for Transocean and 47% for Valaris. The enterprise value of the pro forma company is approximately $17 billion.

item.title: Wins for Companies Across the UK at Annual Subsea Expo Awards in Aberdeen
item.description: Companies and individuals leading the UK’s £9.4 billion underwater industry were honored at the Subsea Expo Awards in Aberdeen recently.

item.title: Nauticus Robotics Announces Strategic Investment and UAE Expansion with Master Investment Group
item.description: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. (Nauticus), a developer of autonomous subsea robotics and software solutions for offshore energy and industrial applications, announced the signing of an agreement for a strategic investment of up to $50 million with Master Investment Group.

item.title: Scottish Africa Business Association Strengthens Subsea Links with Egypt at Subsea Expo
item.description: The Scottish Africa Business Association (SABA) has strengthened international links and opened new opportunities for Scottish companies following a highly successful presence at Subsea Expo in Aberdeen, organized by the Global Underwater Hub.

item.title: SEA.AI Wins Jury’s Special at EUROMARITIME 2026
item.description: SEA.AI has been awarded the Jury’s “Coup de Cœur”, the Special Mention of the EUROMARITIME Awards 2026, a distinction created by the jury to recognize a technology that stood out for its transformative impact on maritime situational awareness.

item.title: Bureau Veritas Grants Approval in Principle to Greenroom Robotics’ Advanced Maritime Autonomy Software
item.description: Bureau Veritas Marine & Offshore (BV) has granted an Approval in Principle (AiP) to Greenroom Robotics for its maritime autonomy software, GAMA. This is the first time a maritime autonomy software enabling self-navigation has been granted AiP by Bureau Veritas, marking a key advancement for maritime robotics and autonomous operations.

item.title: CMA CGM Group, Marlink, and Eutelsat Partner to Deploy OneWeb LEO Connectivity
item.description: CMA CGM Group, Marlink, and Eutelsat have announced a partnership to deploy OneWeb LEO connectivity across CMA CGM’s global maritime fleet. The solution integrates European-based Eutelsat OneWeb’s Low Earth Orbit (LEO) services combined with existing LEO and GEO networks within a broader hybrid network architecture, enabled by Marlink’s purpose-built edge platform, XChange NextGen.

item.title: DOF Group Inks Contract with Shell for Well Intervention Services in North America
item.description: DOF Group ASA (DOF) has announced a substantial contract award with Shell Offshore Inc. for the provision of Hydraulic Subsea Well Intervention Services.

item.title: Saipem Performs Autonomous Mission in the Arctic Coral Area in Norway
item.description: Hydrone-R, Saipem's first resident Underwater Intervention Drone (UID), has completed a new autonomous survey mission over the Arctic coral area of Njord, Norway. The operation was carried out independently, without cables or surface support, contributing to the understanding and protection of marine ecosystems through underwater robotics.
